sources.name: p_schoolagegroup_s
sources.script:
source(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	format: 'parquet') ~> p_schoolagegroup_s

typeProperties.script:
section Section1;
shared p_schoolagegroup_s = let AdfDoc = AzureStorage.DataLakeContents("https://growecdstorage.dfs.core.windows.net/giraffe/parque/p_schoolagegroup_s.parquet"), Parquet = Parquet.Document(AdfDoc) in Parquet;
shared UserQuery = let  
    Source = #"p_schoolagegroup_s",  
  
    #"Changed column type" =  
        Table.TransformColumnTypes(Source,  
        {{"age_group_id", type text}}),  
  
    #"Mapped Age Group" =  
        Table.TransformColumns(#"Changed column type",  
        {{"age_group_id", each   
            if _ = "0 - 2 years old" then "1"  
            else if _ = "2 - 3 years old" then "2"  
            else if _ = "3 - 4 years old" then "3"  
            else if _ = "4 - 5 years old" then "4"  
            else if _ = "5 - 6 years old" then "5"  
            else if _ = "6 - 7 years old" then "6"  
            else _, type text}}),  
  
    #"Removed columns" =  
        Table.RemoveColumns(#"Mapped Age Group",  
        {"renewed_effective_fees", "renewed_effective_date",  
         "created_by", "updated_by",  
         "created_at", "late_early_fee"}),  
  
    #"Renamed columns 1" =  
        Table.RenameColumns(#"Removed columns",  
        {{"age_group_id", "tcbgrow_agegroup"},  
         {"fees", "tcbgrow_fees"},  
         {"id", "tcbgrow_appid"},  
         {"school_id", "tcbgrow_school"}})  
  
in  
    #"Renamed columns 1";

                "schoolStaff","start_date","start_date_import","street_address"

        Table.RenameColumns(  
            SelectColumns,  
            {  
                {"alternative_number", "tcbgrow_alternativenumber"},  
                {"city_id", "cog_city"},  
                {"contact_no", "mobilephone"},  
                {"contact_no_telephone", "telephone1"},

                {"id", "new_staff_id"},  
                {"id_number", "tcbgrow_idnumber"},  
                {"is_active", "statecode"},  
                {"kin_contact_no", "tcbgrow_nextofkincontactnumber"},  
                {"kin_email", "tcbgrow_nextofkinemail"},  
                {"kin_name", "tcbgrow_nextofkinname"},  
                {"kin_relationship_id", "tcbgrow_nextofkinrelationship"},  
                {"last_name", "lastname"},  
                {"middle_name", "middlename"},  
                {"position_id", "tcbgrow_staffrole"},  
                {"region_id", "cog_region"},  
                {"qualification_type_id", "tcbgrow_qualification"},  
                {"race_type_id", "tcbgrow_race"},  
                {"school_id", "tcbgrow_schoolappid"},  
                {"schoolStaff", "tcbgrow_schoolstaff"},  
                {"start_date", "new_start_date"},  
                {"start_date_import", "tcbgrow_startdate"},  
                {"street_address", "tcbgrow_address1"}  
            }  
        ),
  #"Replaced value" = Table.ReplaceValue(RenameColumns, null, "", Replacer.ReplaceValue, {"tcbgrow_alternativenumber", "mobilephone", "telephone1", "emailaddress1", "firstname", "gendercode", "new_staff_id", "tcbgrow_idnumber", "tcbgrow_nextofkincontactnumber", "tcbgrow_nextofkinemail", "tcbgrow_nextofkinname", "lastname", "middlename", "tcbgrow_schoolstaff", "tcbgrow_address1"}),

        {  
            {"tcbgrow_startdate", each Date.From(_), type nullable date},  
            {"new_start_date", each Date.From(_), type nullable date},  
            {"birthdate", each Date.From(_), type nullable date}  
        }  
    )    
  
in  
    #"Calculated date";
